info.name: PhonePe API for Aggregators
info.description:
PhonePe API for Aggregators - Sub-merchant onboarding.

Introduction: Aggregators onboard and manage their sub-merchants on PhonePe. Unlike the PG V2 APIs (which use an O-Bearer token), these legacy aggregator APIs authenticate with the X-VERIFY checksum header and a Base64-encoded request payload.

Authentication (X-VERIFY):
  X-VERIFY = SHA256(base64Payload + apiEndpointPath + saltKey) + "###" + saltIndex
  - For POST: base64Payload is the Base64 of the JSON body; the request body sent is { "request": base64Payload }.
  - For GET: there is no body, so X-VERIFY = SHA256(apiEndpointPath + saltKey) + "###" + saltIndex.
The pre-request scripts in each request compute the Base64 payload and X-VERIFY for you using Postman's built-in CryptoJS.

Folders:
- Sub-merchant -> Create Sub-merchant, Read Sub-merchant

Required environment variables:
- aggregator_base_url  (host, e.g. https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox) -- CONFIRM the exact aggregator host with your PhonePe POC
- aggregator_salt_key, aggregator_salt_index
- merchant_id (aggregator merchant id), aggregator_sub_merchant_id
- submerchant_full_name, submerchant_display_name, submerchant_mcc
- sub_merchant_id (returned by Create; used by Read)

API Endpoints:
- Create Sub-merchant  POST /v1/submerchant
- Read Sub-merchant    GET  /v1/submerchant/{merchantId}/{subMerchantId}

Docs: https://developer.phonepe.com/api-for-aggregators

request.description: Onboard a new sub-merchant under the aggregator. The pre-request script builds the JSON payload (from the environment variables), Base64-encodes it into base64_payload, and computes the X-VERIFY header. Response data contains merchantId, subMerchantId and aggregatorSubMerchantId. https://developer.phonepe.com/api-for-aggregators

const xVerify = CryptoJS.SHA256(base64Payload + endpoint + saltKey).toString() + '###' + saltIndex;
